replacement_solder_field_candidate.observation: Two vertical columns of eight soldered joints repeat in the overlap. In 200509593 they lie near x≈767 and x≈912, y≈1280..1620 with about 48 px row pitch; the corresponding 200506061 field is near x≈2565/2710, y≈1140..1480. This lies immediately above the independently registered D11 solder field, whose x≈2705 column starts at y≈1610 in 200506061. The owner front photo 200358952 shows the marked D104 directly above D11 with their left contact columns nearly aligned. D11's two-face package fit projects the four D104 corner leads onto the field within about 21 px, independently of replica placement. The old x≈2212/2350 fit remains rejected.
replacement_solder_field_candidate.limit: The notch-down orientation and D11-local fit identify the lower joint of the mirrored right column as the photo-registered D104.16 landing. This does not identify its rail: that joint has no exposed local B.Cu departure in the crop, and its F.Cu route is covered by the white cable. The source D11 position now agrees with panorama registration, while both routed boards retain old coordinates. The local pixel fit alone does not identify D104's rail.

front_neighborhood_corroboration.observation: The marked vertical К170УП2 D104 is immediately above the separately marked vertical КР580ВВ51А D11. Their left contact columns are nearly aligned in this single owner image. The two solder rows near x≈2710 and registered D11 x≈2705 likewise align in 200506061, with a roughly 130 px inter-package row gap. The former source PCB placement offset their comparable columns by roughly 14 mm; the panorama registration identified D11 as the larger absolute-position discrepancy, and its source footprint has since been corrected. This historical mismatch did not prove D104 was misplaced.
front_neighborhood_corroboration.decision: Adopt the x≈2565/2710 pair as the photo-registered D104 solder footprint and the lower mirrored-right joint as D104.16. The source D11 position is now corrected; retain D104.16 as an unresolved rail.

supply_pin_local_solder_review.observation: At pin8 the upper left-column solder joint sits on a short bright B.Cu bar reaching an open hole to its west around (2500,1140). At pin15 the second-from-bottom right-column joint has a short B.Cu link east to an open annulus near (2755,1430). The bottom right-column pin16 crown near (2710,1480) is separate and has no visible B.Cu departure. Native crop (2600,1370)-(2820,1560) shows the broad horizontal strip about 35 px below it, with brown clearance rather than a local neck; that strip cannot be used as pin16 rail evidence. These are local copper observations only: neither remote +5 V nor ground anchor is reached in this crop, and pin16's F.Cu route remains cable-covered.
supply_pin_local_solder_review.decision: Use the independently source-assigned pin8/GND and pin15/+5 V as separate meter controls when testing pin16. Do not infer pin16's rail from the neighboring pin15 stub or the parallel horizontal traces.
